description: This file defines a template class 'Archetype' used for generating minimal conforming types based on 'Conformance Profiles'. It includes base classes for various special member functions with properties like noexcept, deleted, or trivial, and provides mechanisms for creating archetypes with specific properties for testing template support and conformance. It also includes comparison operators and hash support conditioned on profile properties.

classes.name: Archetype
classes.description: A template class that models types with specific properties as defined by a Conformance Profile, supporting various special member functions, comparison operators, and hashing based on profile properties.

classes.name: NothrowBool
classes.description: A bool-like class used as the return type for comparison operators that are noexcept.

classes.name: ExceptionalBool
classes.description: A bool-like class used as the return type for comparison operators that may throw.

methods.name: MakeArchetype
methods.description: Creates an archetype instance with a given internal state.
